accessible_name: Three implications reducing halting to provability in Q

accessible_name: Definition of omega consistency
listen_text: If T proves each negative numeral instance of a formula, at zero, one, two, and every further natural number, omega consistency requires that T not prove its positive existential closure. The infinite family is a condition on separate proofs, not a single universally quantified theorem.
